Arata Shiunji has never had a girlfriend, and this celibacy obsesses him, especially since his younger brother already has a girlfriend. But on his youngest sister’s fifteenth birthday, her father makes a statement to the whole family: the siblings have all been adopted. Apart from the twins Shion and Minami, the two boys and the five girls are therefore not related by blood... What impact will this revelation have on Arata?
